description: Update the code block parsing logic to prevent square brackets at the beginning of code content from being incorrectly interpreted as block titles. This ensures that programming language constructs like C# attributes remain part of the code content rather than being extracted as titles.
functional_requirements: Modify the regular expression that parses code block opening lines to only match spaces and tabs (not newlines) before checking for optional title brackets
Ensure code blocks with square brackets in the first line of code (like `[Flags]` in C#) are correctly parsed without extracting those brackets as a title
Maintain existing functionality for code blocks that do have explicit titles in brackets
Add test cases to verify both scenarios: code with square brackets but no title, and code with both a title and square brackets in the content
